05 — Prompt assembly

Part III · Remember · Difficulty: easy-medium · 45 to 60 minutes · 8 graded cases

The agent learns to read the project's own instructions before it starts. It also stops pasting a prompt and starts assembling one, which is what makes chapter 09 possible later.
How it worksoverview.md — the stable prefix, discovery order, and why assembly beats pasting
What to buildproblem.md — the contract, the graded claims, the hints
